answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by anchoring identity to a stochastic beacon that seeds a verifiable delay function, forcing each new node to burn provable work before joining the orchard of active participants. Cross-linking attestations through a bridge contract lets peers weight reputation by bonded stake, so a single actor cannot cheaply fan out identities. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
